layers.message: Add invoice API with CSV export
Record context, scope, and design for invoice JSON export
Route export contract gap to architecture

Correct timestamp and amount formats in API conventions

graderOnly: The corrected docs/conventions.md (Timestamps, Money, and Example sections) matches what src/serialize.js and GET /invoices actually return, so the DOC-001 documentation correction is verified; re-checking it against current inputs confirms this.

docs/api/export.md does not exist. AC-004 requires it, and its content depends on the date-range rules (whether to is inclusive, which time zone from/to use) that Frame 1 leaves for Architect and on DEV-002, which is still PENDING, so the guide cannot be completed now.

Nothing completed downstream is invalidated by the correction: there is no verification report, review report, or synchronization record, and the only DONE implementation step (DEV-001, the serializer) does not depend on docs/conventions.md.
There are no outstanding obligations, independent defects, or blocking user questions.

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { handle } from './src/routes.js'; const fence = String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3); const doc = readFileSync('docs/conventions.md', 'utf8'); const block = doc.split(fence + 'json')[1].split(fence)[0]; const shown = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(block)); const actual = JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(handle('GET', '/invoices/INV-1001').body)); if (shown !== actual) { console.error('example differs: ' + shown + ' / ' + actual); process.exit(1); } console.log('example matches');"
selfChecks.why: the corrected conventions example matches the live handler output field for field, so the correction is verifiable

selfChecks.cmd: git show HEAD~2:docs/conventions.md | grep -q 'Unix epoch seconds' && grep -q 'ISO 8601 strings in UTC' docs/conventions.md
selfChecks.why: the pre-correction guidance was wrong (Unix seconds) and the committed correction describes ISO 8601 UTC
the new API guide required by AC-004 does not exist yet

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): Node ES-module invoice API (src/invoices.js, src/routes.js with inline JSON mapping, src/csv.js), node:test suites, docs/api/invoices.md (accurate) and docs/conventions.md (wrong: Unix seconds and decimal-string amounts, while code emits toISOString() and integer amount_cents). 52-cycle: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-004; AC-004 = new guide docs/api/export.md), design (relies on docs/conventions.md, does not define to-date inclusivity/time zone), STATE at DEVELOPING. 54-serializer: DEV-001 extracts src/serialize.js (DONE, self-check recorded), plan IN_PROGRESS, DEV-002 PENDING. 56-architecture-route: STATE ARCHITECTING with Frame 1 (From DEVELOPING, Owner ARCHITECTING, ResumeAt DEVELOPING, RerunThrough NONE); plan gets Suspended Assignment 1 matching Frame 1 reason. 58-documentation-route: final STATE at DOCUMENTING, Handoff FAILURE from ARCHITECTING (DOCUMENTATION), Frame 2 (Owner DOCUMENTING, ResumeAt ARCHITECTING, RerunThrough NONE). 60-conventions: committed correction of docs/conventions.md with an example that matches handler output. 62-record: documentation record (AUTONOMOUS, ACTIVE_CHANGE, NONE, IN_PROGRESS) holding DOC-001 RESOLVED with inspection and command evidence; remaining active-change documentation marked not yet assessed; it does not state the routing.
